snippet.title: Ravenswatch | Switch 2 Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
RAVENSWATCH: SWITCH 2 EDITION is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on December 10! Sharper visuals, stable 60 FPS and 9 DLC included.

Lead legendary heroes from tales and folklore into the nightmare-plagued Reverie in this action roguelike, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

SWITCH 2 EDITION
▸ Enhanced textures
▸ Full HD resolution
▸ Stable 60 FPS, solo and in online co-op

9 DLC INCLUDED
▸ 3 additional heroes: Romeo, Juliet and Merlin
▸ 7 skin packs to dress every hero in premium outfits

CROSS-PLAY
Still cross-play compatible. Play with your friends, wherever they are!

Nintendo eShop (EU) ► https://www.nintendo.com/fr-fr/Jeux/Jeux-Nintendo-Switch/Ravenswatch-2724931.html
Nintendo eShop (US) ► https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/ravenswatch-switch/

Follow Ravenswatch on X (Twitter) ► https://x.com/PlayRavenswatch
Follow Passtech Games on X (Twitter) ► https://x.com/PasstechGames
